title: Building High-Quality Datasets for Portuguese LLMs: From Common Crawl Snapshots to Industrial-Grade Corpora

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of language models on the Poeta benchmark (comprising 14 diverse Portuguese tasks) to measure the effectiveness of adapting an English-centric model to Portuguese through continued pretraining on curated, language-specific corpora.

Developing and evaluating a custom classifier (ClassiCC-PT-toxic) to detect offensive language, hate speech, and stereotypes within the Portuguese pretraining dataset, measuring its precision, recall, and F1 score against GPT-4o annotations.
